heroTitle: Turn any room into a live quiz show
heroSubtitle: Questly is a real-time quiz platform for classrooms, teams, and events. Host engaging sessions in seconds — players join instantly from their phones, no app required.

features.title: Real-time from start to finish
features.description: Questions, answers, and leaderboards update live for every player the instant you move forward.

features.title: Built for every kind of question
features.description: Single & multiple choice, true/false, short answer, word clouds, calculated answers, and more.

features.title: No app, no friction
features.description: Players join in seconds from any phone or laptop browser using a simple game PIN.

features.title: Speaks your language
features.description: Built-in support for 7 languages, so every player feels at home.

steps.title: Create your quiz
steps.description: Build your questions in the editor — pick from several question types.

steps.title: Share the PIN
steps.description: Players join at questly.co.ke in seconds, no signup needed.

steps.title: Play together, live
steps.description: Host the session and watch the leaderboard update in real time.
